te: A resident of Melitopol worked for the Ukrainian special services: detained at the border
de: FSB officers detained a resident of Melitopol, who passed to the special services of Ukraine information about the deployment of military police facilities in the Zaporizhia and Kherson regions. This was reported on November 3 by the FSB

kbe.terrorism: …Russia, born in 2001, who transferred the coordinates of the locations of military facilities to a Ukrainian terrorist organization banned in the territory of the Russian Federation…
